- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Shows small dark brown spots with extensive yellowing — similar but spots appear less discrete/pustular

**Key comparison:**
- Test image shows the **leaf underside** (pale white veins clearly visible)
- Small, discrete, dark brown/reddish-brown spots that appear slightly raised/pustular
- Scattered pattern with surrounding chlorotic/yellow areas
- This closely matches the soybean rust microscope reference image showing uredinia pustules on lower leaf surface

The pustule-like appearance of the spots on the underside of the leaf, combined with the chlorotic surrounding tissue, aligns best with **Soybean_rust**.
